valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.ember.desc: Woke while burning: coated, fire barely touches you.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.rooted.desc: Woke refusing to fall: coated, nothing knocks you back.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.bulwark.desc: Woke protecting another: Reinforcement covers a groupmate beside you.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.hollow.desc: Woke killing a caster: coated blows drain a caster's mana.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.undying.desc: Woke rising from the ground: under three hearts the coating drains at half.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.hunter.desc: Woke against a beast: your Senses reach half again as far.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.duelist.desc: Woke against a stronger fighter: coated blows stagger twice as often.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.origin.skyward.desc: Woke in the air, or against something on wings: it shows as wings, after one of the great dragons. Coated, they wrap round you as armour, swing clear of your blows and beat attacks back on their own while the pool lasts. From Kindled, double-tap jump in the air to fly on your Valor.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.bent.survivor.desc: Being Spent lasts half as long.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.awe.0: Look at their arms... that's Valor!
valor.jaymoskingdoms.awe.2: Bless you, friend. Stay a while.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.awe.3: My father had that look. You honour us.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.spar.start: Let's see what yours is made of. Come on!
valor.jaymoskingdoms.spar.won: Ha! You've got it, all right. Go on, it's yours to grow.
valor.jaymoskingdoms.spar.lost: Not yet. Come back when you've bled a bit more.
